# The dock validator pair (generated by dockpair.py)

## The box and its pack

| item | value |
|---|---|
| a dock with no validator, typical draw | 10.4 W |
| a dock with the validator and the frame engine, typical draw | 40.8 W |
| usable pack energy | 19.3 Wh |
| a mains outage, plain dock, no Leaf charge | 111 min |
| a mains outage, dock with the validator | 28 min |
| the same, with the Leaf at the 2.24 W session | 27 min |

## The joint loss of power and primary validator, events per hour

| design | rate | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| the pair, one box | 5.60e-04 | one box event takes both |
| a split design, two power domains | 9.33e-06 | a power loss inside a validator outage |
| ratio | 60 | the pair makes the joint loss this many times more frequent |

The rates are `[HYPOTHESIS]` except the validator crash and outage figures, which come from `net/discovery`.


## The cases, by tier

| case | frames at the face | Bare | Buffer | Full | state lost | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 box dies, a shadow in another power domain | 4 to 5 covered by U1 | live 2.23 s, hold 16.2 min | live 23.2 min, hold 16.2 min | live 5.62 h, hold 0 s | none finalized, at most the in-flight inputs | holds while a host arrives in time |
| F1 box dies, no shadow | cold start 133 ms p50, 152 ms p99 | live 2.23 s, hold 16.2 min | live 23.2 min, hold 16.2 min | live 5.62 h, hold 0 s | none finalized, at most the in-flight inputs | holds, the cold start fits in every live time |
| F2 uplink dies, the Leaf has its own 5G | 0, the Leaf dual-sends over its own radio | live | live | live | none | holds |
| F2 uplink dies, the Leaf has no other path | 0 seen, the session is local only | live, unfinalized | live, unfinalized | live, unfinalized | all inputs since the last finality if the box then dies, up to 7 s | LOSS: stated as LOCAL on the class line |
| F3 power path dies, link lives | 0, the same validator keeps serving | live 2.23 s, hold 16.2 min, then a pause to the same box | live 23.2 min, hold 16.2 min, then a pause to the same box | live 5.62 h, hold 0 s, then a pause to the same box | none | holds |
| F4 validator dies, power lives | 4 to 5 covered by U1 from WARM, 0 from HOT | live on the host, no store used | live on the host, no store used | live on the host, no store used | none | holds |
| F5 thermal overload | as F4: the dock sheds the validator before the Leaf charge | live on the host | live on the host | live on the host | none | holds by the priority list of hw/dock |
| F6 a hostile pair cuts power, then serves old state | the Leaf resumes only a root that matches the chain | pause, then a refused resume | pause, then a refused resume | pause, then a refused resume | none, the resume is refused | holds by RG-19 rules 4 and 5 |

## The shadow takeover

The unplanned gap from WARM is `4` frames at p50 and `5` at p99. A cold start on a new validator takes `133 ms` at p50 and `152 ms` at p99.
